slack: 7 New tasks have been added to Trello!
csv: Resolve the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload. This is the top crasher affecting 4% of Android sessions. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, and return to the app.
Develop a sync API endpoint where the client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Implement last-write-wins conflict resolution for this pass.

Build the client-side functionality for offline notes mode, including a local cache using Room, queuing writes while offline, and replaying them when connectivity is restored. Acceptance criteria must be written into the ticket.
Migrate build, test, and release pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Maintain the nightly build schedule. Run both systems in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins.

Implement per-user rate limiting on the search endpoint to prevent degradation from misbehaving scripts. Limit to 100 requests per minute per user, returning HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Add a metrics counter to track users hitting the limit.

Rebuild the consent screen to meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Acquire new copy from legal. Consent must be opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing. Nothing should be pre-checked. This is a launch blocker for the August 20th release.

Create automated regression tests for the payments flow to prevent regressions in future releases. Tests should cover purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. They must run in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
